def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full-width separator row. The panels on its sides map their
    # shared color to the output background; where both aligned cells have
    # that color, output 3 instead.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    if rows:
        sep = min(rows, key=lambda r: abs(r - (h - 1) / 2))
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
        shared = {v for row in a for v in row} & {v for row in b for v in row}
        color = min(shared)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]

    # Alternatively split at a full-height separator column.
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = min(cols, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
    a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = {v for row in a for v in row} & {v for row in b for v in row}
    color = min(shared)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(min(len(a[0]), len(b[0])))] for r in range(h)]
